name: Nouko
source: Nouko is a really creepy character. As it turns out, this crazy freak wears an eyepatch and swings a cutter knife around as if she’s a yandere… Wait, she is one! From the beginning, the player can see that Nouko has some kind of obsession for [url=https://vndb.org/c22681]Nitori[/url], slashing people who get in her way, and finally jumping off a building when she can’t find him. Nouko is a strange character indeed, but when it comes to Nitori, everything else becomes second to her: she simply loves him so much that it’s actually kinda scary.
